question: Can a completed-bar proxy for the immediately prior physical phase's accepted inventory support a naturally high-cadence, after-cost CL-discovered/MCL-executed lifecycle without any outcome-selected risk knob?

windows.validation_law: sealed unless every frozen discovery gate passes

signal.inventory_proxy: one-cent completed-five-minute close bins weighted by completed volume from the immediately preceding GTH or RTH phase; deterministic tie nearest weighted mean then lower tick; not true volume-at-price POC
signal.opening_side: dominant CL opening print relative to its own prior-phase mode
signal.acceptance: first completed fifteen minutes leave both CL and MCL on the CL opening side of their own modes; follow
signal.failure: first completed fifteen minutes leave both CL and MCL opposite the CL opening side of their own modes; fade
signal.entry: next available matched-month MCL open after the completed verdict
signal.position_owner: one position spans both phase clocks; any later GTH/RTH event abstains while occupied

lifecycle.ordinary_exit: at a completed five-minute boundary, require both CL and MCL closes to cross their own frozen phase modes against the position; execute at next MCL open
lifecycle.session_or_contract_boundary: flatten at last available MCL close
lifecycle.unexpected_within_session_gap: flatten at first available MCL open
lifecycle.discovery_validation_boundary: flatten before validation so validation owns an independent flat start

economics.entry_exit_prices: MCL next open except declared boundary closes

discovery_gates.directions: up and down each >=20 trades and stress-positive
discovery_gates.branches: acceptance and failure each >=20 trades and stress-positive
discovery_gates.phases: GTH and RTH each >=50 trades and stress-positive
discovery_gates.weekend: weekend GTH >=20 and stress-positive; all other trades >=50 and stress-positive
discovery_gates.density: median 1-2, p95 <=2, maximum <=2 trades per active session

validation_and_full_gates.all_other_full_gates: repeat discovery law on the combined flat-boundary ledger

hard_limits.missing_july_2023_to_august_2024: hard crown blocker even if development passes
hard_limits.outcome_tuning: no threshold, bin, magnitude, time, exit, branch, or companion may be changed after this freeze
